objective: arithmetic mean of latent posterior variance across the seven graph nodes
sample_rule: Each robot samples once after each move, including wait. All measurement noises are independent.
motion_rule: Each labeled robot moves at most one graph edge per step. Waiting allowed. Same-node collision and pairwise swaps forbidden.
scope: Paper-independent, deterministic finite-model diagnostic; not an ECC paper reproduction, SOGP implementation, novelty claim, or continuous-time safety certificate.
